## Load data

```{r load-rds}
rtB4rar                      <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rtB4rar.rds"))
rt_subclades                 <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_subclades.rds"))
rt_g                         <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_g.rds"))
curto_unrar_otutab           <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "curto_unrar_otutab.rds"))
genus_unrar_otutab           <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "genus_unrar_otutab.rds"))
curto_subclades_unrar_otutab <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "curto_subclades_unrar_otutab.rds"))
genus_min_sample             <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "genus_min_sample.rds"))
metadata                     <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "metadata.rds"))
```

## Compute distance matrices

```{r dist-matrices}
set.seed(SEED)

mg_subclds_distmat <- avgdist(curto_subclades_unrar_otutab,
                              sample     = RAREFY_DEPTH_SUBCL,
                              upper      = FALSE,
                              iterations = 1000)

mg_genus_distmat   <- avgdist(genus_unrar_otutab,
                              sample     = genus_min_sample,
                              upper      = FALSE,
                              iterations = 100)
```

---

## PERMANOVAs — Curtobacterium subclade level

### ⚠️ Dispersion check before PERMANOVAs

**It is important to verify that groups do not differ in multivariate dispersion
(variance), otherwise a significant `adonis2` result may reflect dispersion
rather than location differences.**

```{r dispersion-check-subclade}
# Example: test dispersion for LOMA-inoculum samples by s_home
i_loma_data <- metadata |>
  filter(Bag_type == "Closed", i_code == "LOMA")

dm_full      <- as.matrix(mg_subclds_distmat)
i_loma_dm    <- as.dist(dm_full[sort(i_loma_data$original_label),
                                sort(i_loma_data$original_label)])

bd_loma <- betadisper(i_loma_dm,
                      group = i_loma_data$s_home[match(labels(i_loma_dm),
                                                       i_loma_data$original_label)])
permutest(bd_loma, permutations = 999)
```

### PERMANOVA: LOMA-inoculum samples — effect of substrate home/away × reserve

```{r permanova-loma-inoc}
adonis2(i_loma_dm ~ s_home * reserve_code,
        data         = i_loma_data,
        by           = "terms",
        permutations = 999)
```

### Export LOMA-inoculum distance matrix for PRIMER

```{r export-loma-dm}
out_file <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "tables", "i_loma_dm_s_home.csv")
dir.create(dirname(out_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

i_loma_md <- i_loma_data |>
  dplyr::select(s_code, reserve_code, s_home) |>
  t()

write.csv(dm_full[sort(i_loma_data$original_label), sort(i_loma_data$original_label)],
          file = out_file, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
cat("\n", file = out_file, append = TRUE)
write.table(i_loma_md, file = out_file, sep = ",", quote = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, append = TRUE)
```

### PERMANOVA per reserve: substrate × inoculum

```{r permanova-by-reserve}
# Bug fix: use name-based exclusion rather than a magic index
reserves <- sort(unique(metadata$reserve_code))
reserves <- reserves[reserves != "LOMA"]

permanova_by_reserve <- map(reserves, function(res) {
  test    <- metadata |>
    filter(reserve_code == res, Bag_type == "Closed", i_code != "none")
  samples <- sort(unique(test$original_label))
  dm_sub  <- as.dist(dm_full[samples, samples])

  # Dispersion test before PERMANOVA
  bd <- betadisper(dm_sub,
                   group = test$s_code[match(labels(dm_sub), test$original_label)])
  cat(res, "— dispersion test p =", permutest(bd, permutations = 999)$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"], "\n")

  ad <- adonis2(dm_sub ~ s_code * i_code,
                data         = test,
                by           = "terms",
                permutations = 999)

  # Export for PRIMER
  out_file <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "tables", paste0("dm_", res, ".csv"))
  write.csv(as.matrix(dm_sub), file = out_file, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
  cat("\n", file = out_file, append = TRUE)
  md_mat <- test |> dplyr::select(s_code, i_code) |> t()
  write.table(md_mat, file = out_file, sep = ",", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, append = TRUE)
  ad
})
names(permanova_by_reserve) <- reserves

# Tidy summary table
anova_tables <- imap_dfr(permanova_by_reserve, ~ {
  tidy(.x) |> mutate(reserve_code = .y)
})

# ⚠️ Multiple-comparison note:
# These tests are run across 8 reserves. No correction for multiple testing has
# been applied. Consider Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment for the p.value column.
anova_tables |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) |>
  filter(term != "Residual") |>
  arrange(reserve_code, term)
```

### PERMANOVA per inoculum: effect of reserve (climate) on community

```{r permanova-by-inoculum}
inoculum <- sort(unique(metadata$i_code))
inoculum <- inoculum[!inoculum %in% c("none", "LOMA")]

permanova_by_inoculum <- map(inoculum, function(inoc) {
  test <- metadata |>
    filter(Bag_type == "Closed", i_code == inoc, s_code != "LOMA")

  if (n_distinct(test$reserve_code) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", inoc, ": < 2 reserves present.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  samples <- sort(unique(test$original_label))
  dm_sub  <- as.dist(dm_full[samples, samples])

  bd <- betadisper(dm_sub,
                   group = test$reserve_code[match(labels(dm_sub), test$original_label)])
  cat(inoc, "— dispersion test p =", permutest(bd, permutations = 999)$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"], "\n")

  adonis2(dm_sub ~ reserve_code,
          data         = test,
          by           = "terms",
          permutations = 999)
})
names(permanova_by_inoculum) <- inoculum

anova_tables_inoc <- imap_dfr(permanova_by_inoculum, ~ {
  if (is.null(.x)) return(tibble())
  tidy(.x) |> mutate(i_code = .y)
})
anova_tables_inoc |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) |>
  filter(term != "Residual")
```

## PERMANOVAs — Bacterial genus level

```{r permanova-genus-loma-inoc}
tst_dm_genus <- as.matrix(mg_genus_distmat)

i_loma_dm_genus <- as.dist(tst_dm_genus[sort(i_loma_data$original_label),
                                         sort(i_loma_data$original_label)])

bd_loma_g <- betadisper(i_loma_dm_genus,
                         group = i_loma_data$s_home[match(labels(i_loma_dm_genus),
                                                          i_loma_data$original_label)])
permutest(bd_loma_g, permutations = 999)

adonis2(i_loma_dm_genus ~ s_home * reserve_code,
        data         = i_loma_data,
        by           = "terms",
        permutations = 999)
```

```{r permanova-by-reserve-genus}
permanova_by_reserve_genus <- map(reserves, function(res) {
  test    <- metadata |>
    filter(reserve_code == res, Bag_type == "Closed", i_code != "none")
  samples <- sort(unique(test$original_label))
  dm_sub  <- as.dist(tst_dm_genus[samples, samples])

  bd <- betadisper(dm_sub,
                   group = test$s_code[match(labels(dm_sub), test$original_label)])
  cat(res, "genus — dispersion test p =",
      permutest(bd, permutations = 999)$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"], "\n")

  ad <- adonis2(dm_sub ~ s_code * i_code,
                data         = test,
                by           = "terms",
                permutations = 999)

  out_file <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "tables", paste0("dm_", res, "_genus.csv"))
  write.csv(as.matrix(dm_sub), file = out_file, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
  cat("\n", file = out_file, append = TRUE)
  md_mat <- test |> dplyr::select(s_code, i_code) |> t()
  write.table(md_mat, file = out_file, sep = ",", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, append = TRUE)
  ad
})
names(permanova_by_reserve_genus) <- reserves

anova_tables_genus <- imap_dfr(permanova_by_reserve_genus, ~ {
  tidy(.x) |> mutate(reserve_code = .y)
})
```

```{r permanova-by-inoculum-genus}
permanova_by_inoculum_genus <- map(inoculum, function(inoc) {
  test <- metadata |>

  samples <- sort(unique(test$original_label))

# Bug fix: was using anova_tables_inoc (curto) here — now uses the genus version
anova_tables_inoc_genus <- imap_dfr(permanova_by_inoculum_genus, ~ {
  if (is.null(.x)) return(tibble())
  tidy(.x) |> mutate(i_code = .y)
```

## PRIMER variance explained summary

```{r primer-summary}
primer_permanovas <- read.csv(
  here::here("results", "PERMANOVAS_Primer", "PERMANOVAS_primer.csv"),
  header = TRUE
)

primer_permanovas_genus <- read.csv(
  here::here("results", "PERMANOVAS_Primer", "PERMANOVAS_primer_genus.csv"),
  header = TRUE
)

factor_colors <- c(
  "Climate" = "#C8A2C8",
  "Climate x Litter" = "#8E44AD",
  "Climate x MC" = "#4B0082",
  "Litter" = "#A9745B",
  "Litter x MC" = "#5C4033",
  "MC" = "#6E8B3D"
)


primer_permanovas <- primer_permanovas |>
  mutate(pct_var = as.numeric(str_remove(na_if(X..var..explained, ""), "%")) |> replace_na(0))

primer_permanovas_summary <- primer_permanovas |>
  group_by(Source) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pct = mean(pct_var, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD       = sd(pct_var,   na.rm = TRUE),
    SE       = SD / sqrt(n()),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )


primer_permanovas_genus <- primer_permanovas_genus |>
  mutate(pct_var = as.numeric(str_remove(na_if(X..var..explained, ""), "%")) |> replace_na(0))

primer_permanovas_summary_genus <- primer_permanovas_genus |>
  group_by(Source) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pct = mean(pct_var, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD       = sd(pct_var,   na.rm = TRUE),
    SE       = SD / sqrt(n()),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) 

### PLOT FOR CURTO COMMUNITY

primer_permanvovas_summary_plot <- ggplot(primer_permanovas_summary, aes(x = Source, y = mean_pct, fill = Source)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_pct - SE, ymax = mean_pct + SE),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = primer_permanovas, aes(x = Source, y = pct_var),
              width = 0.15, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = factor_colors,
                    labels = c("Climate"          = "Site",
                               "Climate x Litter" = "Site x Litter",
                               "Climate x MC"     = "Site x Inoculum",
                               "Litter"           = "Litter",
                               "Litter x MC"      = "Litter x Inoculum",
                               "MC"               = "Inoculum")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 40)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
        legend.position        = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(1, 1),
        legend.justification   = c(1, 1),
        legend.background      = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), colour = NA),
        legend.key.size        = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text            = element_text(size = 8))

print(primer_permanvovas_summary_plot)

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "PERMANOVAS_var_exp.png"),
       width = 120, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")


### PLOT FOR WHOLE BACTERIAL COMMUNITY

primer_permanvovas_genus_summary_plot <- ggplot(primer_permanovas_summary_genus, aes(x = Source, y = mean_pct, fill = Source)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_pct - SE, ymax = mean_pct + SE),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = factor_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 40)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
        legend.position        = "none",
        legend.position.inside = c(1, 1),
        legend.justification   = c(1, 1),
        legend.background      = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), colour = NA),
        legend.key.size        = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text            = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "PERMANOVAS_var_exp_GENUS.png"),

       width = 140,
       height = 120,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```

### PRIMER variance explained summary tables

```{r permanova-total-var-explained}
# Total variance explained per experiment (all terms, including non-significant as 0)
curto_total <- primer_permanovas |>
  group_by(pair) |>
  summarise(total_var = sum(pct_var), .groups = "drop")

curto_total_source <- primer_permanovas |>
  group_by(Source) |>
  summarise(Mean.var = mean(pct_var), .groups = "drop")

print(curto_total_source)

genus_total <- primer_permanovas_genus |>
  group_by(pair) |>
  summarise(total_var = sum(pct_var), .groups = "drop")

genus_total_source <- primer_permanovas_genus |>
  group_by(Source) |>
  summarise(Mean.var = mean(pct_var), .groups = "drop")

print(genus_total_source)


# Per-pair comparison
total_var_by_pair <- curto_total |>
  mutate(community = "Curtobacterium") |>
  bind_rows(genus_total |> mutate(community = "Bacterial community")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = community, values_from = total_var) |>
  arrange(pair) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))

print(total_var_by_pair)

# Summary across 8 experiments
total_var_summary <- curto_total |>
  summarise(mean_total = mean(total_var), SD = sd(total_var),
            SE = SD / sqrt(n()), min = min(total_var), max = max(total_var)) |>
  mutate(community = "Curtobacterium") |>
  bind_rows(
    genus_total |>
      summarise(mean_total = mean(total_var), SD = sd(total_var),
                SE = SD / sqrt(n()), min = min(total_var), max = max(total_var)) |>
      mutate(community = "Bacterial community")
  ) |>
  select(community, everything()) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))

print(total_var_summary)

# Per-pair comparison
total_var_by_source <- curto_total_source |>
  mutate(community = "Curtobacterium") |>
  bind_rows(genus_total_source |> mutate(community = "Bacterial community")) #|>
  pivot_wider(names_from = community, values_from = total_var) |>
  arrange(community)

print(total_var_by_source)

write_xlsx(
  total_var_by_source,
  path = file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "tables", "PERMANOVA_by_source_summaries.xlsx")
)


```

## Build pair-comparison membership table

This encodes which samples belong to which treatment comparison within each
reserve pair. Used downstream in the convergence analysis.

```{r build-membership}
clean_label <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)

meta_filt <- metadata |>
  filter(Bag_type != "Open", i_code != "none") |>
  add_pair_label() |>
  add_irl_label()

# Expand LOMA-vs-LOMA rows into every away-vs-LOMA pair context
others   <- setdiff(unique(meta_filt$reserve_code), "LOMA")
meta_ext <- expand_loma_rows(meta_filt, others)

# Add extra derived columns used in plots and convergence analysis
meta_ext <- meta_ext |>
  mutate(
    treatment3 = paste(treatment_2, pair, sep = "|"),
    i_r_l = case_when(
      i_code == "LOMA" ~ paste(i_code, reserve_litter, sep = "|"),
      i_code != "LOMA" ~ paste("away",  reserve_litter, sep = "|")
    )
  )

# Build all pairwise comparisons within each pair context
pair_trts <- meta_ext |>
  distinct(pair, i_r_l) |>
  group_by(pair) |>
  summarise(trts = list(sort(unique(i_r_l))), .groups = "drop")

comps <- pair_trts |>
  mutate(cmb = map(trts, ~ if (length(.x) < 2) list()
                            else combn(.x, 2, simplify = FALSE))) |>
  select(pair, cmb) |>
  unnest(cmb) |>
  transmute(
    pair,
    t1      = map_chr(cmb, 1),
    t2      = map_chr(cmb, 2),
    comp_id = paste0(clean_label(t1), "__vs__", clean_label(t2))
  )

A <- meta_ext |>
  inner_join(comps, by = c("pair", "i_r_l" = "t1"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  mutate(grp = "A")

B <- meta_ext |>
  inner_join(comps, by = c("pair", "i_r_l" = "t2"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  mutate(grp = "B")

membership <- bind_rows(A, B) |>
  select(original_label, pair, comp_id, grp, treatment_2, i_code,
         reserve_code, s_code, i_r_l) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(pair, comp_id, grp)

# All pairwise community distances per comparison
pair_comp_dists <- calculate_comp_dists(mg_subclds_distmat, membership)
```
